units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 10:2">Targ. Ps. X, 2</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="P00982"><he>עֲנִיָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 16:3">Targ. Y. Deut. XVI, 3</cite> <he>לחמא ע׳</he> poor bread (h. text <he>לחם עֹנִי</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 155b:12">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>לית דע׳ מכלבא וכ׳</he> none is poorer than the dog, none richer than the swine.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92a:24">B. Kam. 92ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (prov.) <he>בתר ע׳ אזלא עניותא</he> poverty follows the poor, i.e. the poor man is always under a disadvantage.

<cite ref="Ketubot 106b:14">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite> (managers must not trade with the poor fund) <he>דילמא מתרמי להו ע׳ וכ׳</he> lest the case of a poor man come up before them, and they have no cash to give him; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲנִיֵּי</he>.
